milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The yellow banner is placed at spawn-relative (5, 1, 7) inside the oak hut. The player must navigate within 16 blocks of the banner and face toward it (within 60° tolerance), modeling that the player has visually located the banner. This rule type is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it correctly captures both proximity and visual observation.

scene_description: A small village-like setting with two structures: an open oak hut (with yellow banner inside) and a stone brick building, connected by a grass path with lantern-topped fence posts. The yellow banner is placed inside the oak hut, requiring the agent to navigate to and look inside the structure to find it.
task_text: Find the yellow banner in the scene. Look around the structures and locate it.
design_notes: The yellow banner is at ~5 ~1 ~7, inside the oak hut (entrance facing south at z=5). The stone brick building is to the northwest. Two lantern posts mark the central path. The agent spawns at origin facing the structures and must navigate to the oak hut to find the banner. The banner is visible from the hut entrance (confirmed in step_019 of sandbox preview).
